powershell: $app = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "Programs\Notion"; $exe1 = Join-Path $app "Notion.exe"; if (-not (Test-Path $exe1)) { winget install --id Notion.Notion -e --silent --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements --source winget }; "APP-SRC-EXISTS: " + (Test-Path $exe1); Stop-Process -Name "Notion" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ((Test-Path $app) -and (-not (Test-Path "E:\Notion\Notion.exe"))) { Move-Item $app "E:\Notion" }; if (-not (Test-Path $app)) { cmd /c mklink /J "$app" "E:\Notion" }; $data = Join-Path $env:APPDATA "Notion"; if ((Test-Path $data) -and (-not (Test-Path "E:\NotionData"))) { Move-Item $data "E:\NotionData" }; if ((Test-Path "E:\NotionData") -and (-not (Test-Path $data))) { cmd /c mklink /J "$data" "E:\NotionData" }; "EXE-ON-E: " + (Test-Path "E:\Notion\Notion.exe"); (Get-Item "E:\Notion\Notion.exe").VersionInfo.ProductVersion; Start-Process "E:\Notion\Notion.exe"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; Get-Process "Notion" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, StartTime; Stop-Process -Name "Notion" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "LAUNCH-TEST-DONE"
